parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can view your application IDs by navigating to **ApsaraVideo Live > Live+ > ApsaraVideo Real-time Communication > Application Management**.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The current page number, starting from 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.
